mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points from the prior month signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate housing sector contraction, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) declining below 100 (index base 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and earnings potential, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Real personal consumption (RSAFS) exceeding its 12-month moving average signals robust consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS > 12-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL year-over-year inflation exceeding 2.5% signals accelerating price pressures, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate labor market squeeze, signaling potential recession and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS and UNRATE both decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below its 6-month moving average signals manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate capacity utilization and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 6-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.03.
